articles.title: 小胶质细胞激活通过CA3-CA1神经回路破坏海马CA1尖波涟漪，导致老年小鼠术后记忆巩固缺陷。
articles.originalTitle: Microglial activation disrupts hippocampal CA1 sharp-wave ripples via the CA3-CA1 neural circuit that contributes to postoperative memory consolidation deficits in aged mice.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: Memory impairment is a common postoperative neurological complication among elderly patients. Sharp-wave ripples (SPW-Rs) in the CA1 region of the hippocampus play a critical role in memory consolidation. However, the extent to which disruptions in CA1 SPW-Rs contribute to postoperative memory impairment remains poorly understood. METHODS: An 18-month-old male C57BL/6J mice were exposed to 3 vol% sevoflurane combined with laparotomy. Various methodologies, including context fear conditioning, local field potential monitoring, immunofluorescence staining, viral tracing, optogenetics, and chemogenetics, were used to elucidate the involvement of SPW-Rs in the CA1 region in postoperative memory impairment in aged mice. RESULTS: Postoperative memory impairment in aged mice was associated with deficits in memory consolidation, characterised by a reduced SPW-R frequency and duration in the CA1 region. Induction of SPW-Rs had the potential to improve memory consolidation (from 34.3 [9.4] to 53.1 [18.7]%, P=0.016). Additionally, we observed a decrease in the number of c-Fos-positive pyramidal neurones in the CA3 region following surgery, which contributed to diminished excitatory transmission to the CA1 region. Activating CA3 pyramidal neurones through chemogenetic approaches restored activity in CA1 pyramidal neurones, ameliorating SPW-R disruption (frequency from 0.20 [0.05] to 0.25 [0.15] events s(-1), P=0.018; duration from 0.034 [0.0028] to 0.039 [0.0033] s, P=0.014) and memory impairment. Microglial activation was associated with SPW-R disruption and postoperative memory deficits. CONCLUSIONS: Surgery triggers microglial activation, leading to the release of neuroinflammatory factors that inhibit hippocampal CA3 pyramidal neurone activation, ultimately disrupting SPW-R dynamics and impairing memory consolidation.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: 记忆障碍是老年患者术后常见的神经系统并发症。海马CA1区的尖波涟漪（SPW-Rs）在记忆巩固中发挥关键作用。然而，CA1 SPW-Rs的破坏在多大程度上导致术后记忆障碍仍知之甚少。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 将18月龄雄性C57BL/6J小鼠暴露于3 vol%七氟烷联合剖腹手术。使用多种方法，包括情境恐惧条件反射、局部场电位监测、免疫荧光染色、病毒示踪、光遗传学和化学遗传学，以阐明CA1区SPW-Rs在老年小鼠术后记忆障碍中的作用。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 老年小鼠术后记忆障碍与记忆巩固缺陷相关，其特征为CA1区SPW-R频率和持续时间降低。诱导SPW-Rs有可能改善记忆巩固（从34.3 [9.4]%到53.1 [18.7]%，P=0.016）。此外，我们观察到手术后CA3区c-Fos阳性锥体神经元数量减少，导致对CA1区的兴奋性传递减弱。通过化学遗传学方法激活CA3锥体神经元可恢复CA1锥体神经元活动，改善SPW-R破坏（频率从0.20 [0.05]到0.25 [0.15] events s(-1)，P=0.018；持续时间从0.034 [0.0028]到0.039 [0.0033] s，P=0.014）和记忆障碍。小胶质细胞激活与SPW-R破坏和术后记忆缺陷相关。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 手术触发小胶质细胞激活，导致神经炎症因子释放，抑制海马CA3锥体神经元激活，最终破坏SPW-R动态并损害记忆巩固。

articles.originalTitle: Hydrocodone vs Oxycodone and Postoperative Pain and Opioid Use in Joint Arthroplasty.
articles.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Oxycodone and hydrocodone are the most frequently prescribed opioids for postoperative joint arthroplasty pain, yet comparative effectiveness data remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To compare postoperative pain outcomes and opioid consumption for hydrocodone vs oxycodone among patients undergoing elective joint arthroplasty. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cohort study was a preplanned secondary analysis of a randomized clinical trial conducted among cytochrome P450 2D6 (CYP2D6) normal metabolizers (NMs) who underwent elective joint arthroplasty in 5 US surgery clinical sites from March 2021 to September 2023 and received hydrocodone or oxycodone postoperatively. Follow-up concluded in March 2024. Data analysis was conducted from October 2024 to December 2025. EXPOSURE: Postoperative analgesia with hydrocodone or oxycodone within a multimodal pain management approach (opioids and nonopioids). MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Coprimary outcomes were composite pain score at postoperative day 10 (sum of current, worst, and mean pain over 7 days; range 3-15) and cumulative morphine milligram equivalents (MMEs) over 10 days. Secondary outcomes included mobility scores at day 10 and Patient-Reported Outcomes Measurement Information System anxiety and depression scores at day 30. Multivariable regressions were adjusted for demographic and clinical covariates. RESULTS: Among 663 participants (mean [SD] age, 66 [10.6] years; 384 [57.9%] female), 217 received oxycodone and 446 received hydrocodone. Hydrocodone was associated with significantly lower composite pain scores compared with oxycodone (mean [SD], 9.0 [2.0] vs 9.3 [2.2]; adjusted P = .001) and significantly lower cumulative MME (mean [SD], 93.5 [159.3] vs 154.5 [121.6]; adjusted P < .001). Secondary outcomes did not differ between groups (mobility score: mean [SD], 26.3 [10.4] vs 30.9 [14.7]; P = .29; anxiety score: mean [SD], 45.4 [8.3] vs 45.5 [8.7]; P = .31; depression score: mean [SD], 43.8 [7.8] vs 44.0 [7.9]; P = .97). Findings were consistent in sensitivity analyses, restricting to opioid and acetaminophen combinations, restricting to sites prescribing both opioids, and in subgroups of knee arthroplasty, but not consistent in hip arthroplasty. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study of CYP2D6 NMs undergoing joint arthroplasty, within multimodal analgesia, hydrocodone provided comparable pain control to oxycodone with significantly lower opioid exposure, supporting its use as a viable and possibly preferable analgesic option.

sections.heading: IMPORTANCE
sections.text: 羟考酮和氢可酮是最常用于关节置换术后疼痛的阿片类药物，但比较有效性数据仍然有限。

sections.heading: OBJECTIVE
sections.text: 比较接受择期关节置换术的患者使用氢可酮与羟考酮的术后疼痛结局和阿片类药物消耗量。

sections.heading: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
sections.text: 这项队列研究是一项随机临床试验的预先计划二次分析，该试验在2021年3月至2023年9月期间，于美国5个手术临床站点招募了接受择期关节置换术的细胞色素P450 2D6（CYP2D6）正常代谢者（NMs），术后接受氢可酮或羟考酮。随访于2024年3月结束。数据分析于2024年10月至2025年12月进行。

sections.heading: EXPOSURE
sections.text: 在多模式疼痛管理方法（阿片类和非阿片类药物）中使用氢可酮或羟考酮进行术后镇痛。

sections.heading: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
sections.text: 共同主要结局是术后第10天的复合疼痛评分（当前、最严重和平均疼痛评分之和，评分范围3-15）以及10天内的累积吗啡毫克当量（MMEs）。次要结局包括第10天的活动能力评分以及第30天的患者报告结局测量信息系统焦虑和抑郁评分。多变量回归根据人口统计学和临床协变量进行了调整。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在663名参与者（平均[SD]年龄66[10.6]岁；384名[57.9%]女性）中，217名接受了羟考酮，446名接受了氢可酮。与羟考酮相比，氢可酮与显著更低的复合疼痛评分（平均[SD]，9.0[2.0] vs 9.3[2.2]；调整后P = .001）和显著更低的累积MME（平均[SD]，93.5[159.3] vs 154.5[121.6]；调整后P < .001）相关。次要结局在两组之间没有差异（活动能力评分：平均[SD]，26.3[10.4] vs 30.9[14.7]；P = .29；焦虑评分：平均[SD]，45.4[8.3] vs 45.5[8.7]；P = .31；抑郁评分：平均[SD]，43.8[7.8] vs 44.0[7.9]；P = .97）。敏感性分析结果一致，包括限制于阿片类和对乙酰氨基酚组合、限制于两种阿片类药物均处方的站点以及膝关节置换亚组，但在髋关节置换中不一致。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
sections.text: 在这项针对接受关节置换术的CYP2D6正常代谢者的队列研究中，在多模式镇痛背景下，氢可酮提供了与羟考酮相当的疼痛控制，且阿片类药物暴露显著更低，支持其作为一种可行且可能更优的镇痛选择。

articles.abstract: IMPORTANCE: High-quality evidence guiding opioid prescribing decisions for acute pain across common diagnoses is lacking. OBJECTIVE: To describe pain trajectories and patterns of opioid and nonopioid treatment use among individuals who were offered opioids for the treatment of acute pain. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This was a prospective cohort study of patients recruited from 5 US health systems between September 2020 and March 2023 in emergency departments (EDs), primary care clinics, dental practices, or after cesarean delivery or knee replacement. Eligible patients were opioid-naive adults aged 18 years or older at all study sites, as well as adolescents aged 15 to17 years undergoing impacted molar extraction at 1 site, who were offered an opioid prescription for acute pain. Analysis was conducted April 2023 through February 2026. EXPOSURE: Offer of a prescription for an opioid analgesic. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Time to pain resolution (3 consecutive reports of no pain), patterns of opioid and nonopioid treatment use, and opioid-related adverse effects, ascertained from digital questionnaires. RESULTS: Among 1708 enrolled patients (median age, 38 years [IQR, 28-52 years]; 615 [36.0%] reporting race or ethnicity underrepresented in studies of acute pain management) followed up for 180 days, 915 (53.6%) were recruited in EDs, 307 (18.0%) in primary or urgent care, 263 (15.4%) in dental settings, and 223 (13.1%) in inpatient settings. Pain sources included dental (302 patients [17.7%]), trauma or injury (302 [17.7%]), obstetric (176 [10.3%]), musculoskeletal (131 [7.7%]), and low back (100 [5.9%]). Among 1502 patients reporting pain level at least once, median time to pain resolution irrespective of the treatment approach was 20 days (IQR, 8-88 days), with longer durations for surgical pain (74 days [IQR, 30 days to not reached]) and low back pain (69 days [IQR, 18 days to not reached]). The median time to opioid discontinuation among 1189 patients (69.6%) who reported any opioid use was 7 days (IQR, 2-31 days); an estimated 10.0% (95% CI, 7.7%-12.7%) of patients used opioids for at least 90 days, with higher rates in people reporting frequent pain before enrollment. Of 1482 patients (86.8%) completing at least 1 survey during the first 2 weeks of follow-up, 1153 (77.8%) reported using any opioids and 1287 (86.8%) reported using acetaminophen or ibuprofen. Among 619 (52.1%) patients with any opioid use who reported the dose of opioids taken in the first 15 days, daily doses were low (median, 10 [IQR, 5-15] morphine milligram equivalents). Most respondents reported leftover opioids (657 of 982 responding [66.9%]). CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study of opioid-naive patients with acute pain, opioid use was generally low dose and of short duration, although some patients reported prolonged opioid use; most reported achieving pain resolution within 3 weeks, with longer times for surgical and low back pain. The findings suggest current guidelines for multimodal treatment and for short-duration opioid prescriptions if needed will serve many but not all patients, and treatment should be tailored to address individual patients' needs.

sections.heading: DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS
sections.text: 这是一项前瞻性队列研究，研究对象为2020年9月至2023年3月期间从美国5个医疗系统（急诊科、初级保健诊所、牙科诊所、剖宫产术后或膝关节置换术后）招募的患者。符合条件的患者为所有研究地点年龄≥18岁的阿片类药物初治成人，以及1个地点因阻生磨牙拔除的15-17岁青少年，且均获得急性疼痛的阿片类药物处方。分析时间为2023年4月至2026年2月。

sections.heading: EXPOSURE
sections.text: 获得阿片类镇痛药处方。

sections.heading: MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES
sections.text: 疼痛缓解时间（连续3次报告无痛）、阿片类和非阿片类药物治疗使用模式以及阿片类药物相关不良反应，通过数字问卷获取。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 在1708名入组患者中（中位年龄38岁[IQR，28-52岁]；615名[36.0%]报告在急性疼痛管理研究中代表性不足的种族或民族），随访180天。其中915名（53.6%）在急诊科招募，307名（18.0%）在初级或紧急护理中招募，263名（15.4%）在牙科环境中招募，223名（13.1%）在住院环境中招募。疼痛来源包括牙科（302名患者[17.7%]）、创伤或损伤（302名[17.7%]）、产科（176名[10.3%]）、肌肉骨骼（131名[7.7%]）和腰背痛（100名[5.9%]）。在至少报告一次疼痛水平的1502名患者中，无论采用何种治疗方法，疼痛缓解的中位时间为20天（IQR，8-88天），其中手术痛（74天[IQR，30天至未达到]）和腰背痛（69天[IQR，18天至未达到]）的持续时间更长。在1189名（69.6%）报告任何阿片类药物使用的患者中，停药的中位时间为7天（IQR，2-31天）；估计10.0%（95%CI，7.7%-12.7%）的患者使用阿片类药物至少90天，入组前频繁疼痛的患者中比例更高。在1482名（86.8%）完成随访前2周至少一次调查的患者中，1153名（77.8%）报告使用了任何阿片类药物，1287名（86.8%）报告使用了对乙酰氨基酚或布洛芬。在619名（52.1%）有阿片类药物使用且报告最初15天内阿片类药物剂量的患者中，每日剂量较低（中位数为10[IQR，5-15]吗啡毫克当量）。大多数受访者报告有剩余阿片类药物（657/982，66.9%）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE
sections.text: 在这项针对阿片类药物初治急性疼痛患者的队列研究中，阿片类药物使用通常为低剂量和短期，但部分患者报告了长期使用；大多数患者在3周内实现疼痛缓解，但手术痛和腰背痛时间更长。研究结果表明，当前关于多模式治疗以及必要时短期阿片类药物处方的指南将适用于许多但不包括所有患者，治疗应根据个体患者需求进行调整。

articles.title: 血浆淀粉样蛋白-β 1-40 与心脏手术后谵妄
articles.originalTitle: Plasma Amyloid-beta 1-40 and Postoperative Delirium After Cardiac Surgery.
articles.abstract: IMPORTANCE: Postoperative delirium (POD) is a frequent and severe complication after cardiac surgery that is associated with increased risk of dementia and adverse outcomes. Early identification of high-risk patients remains challenging. OBJECTIVE: To examine whether preoperative plasma Alzheimer disease biomarkers are associated with baseline cognition and can independently estimate POD in patients undergoing elective cardiac surgery. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This prospective, observational cohort study (FIND Delirium Risk Factors [FINDERI]) included patients 50 years or older undergoing elective cardiac surgery at a comprehensive cardiac surgery center in Germany between February 1, 2021, and October 31, 2022. Statistical analysis was performed from January to December 2025. EXPOSURES: Preoperative plasma concentrations of amyloid-beta 1-40 (Abeta1-40), amyloid-beta 42 (Abeta1-42), phosphorylated tau 181 (pTau181), and phosphorylated tau 217 (pTau217) were measured using validated immunoassays between November 1, 2022, and July 31, 2024. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: The primary outcome was POD, assessed daily for 5 days postoperatively using the Confusion Assessment Method algorithm. Baseline cognitive function was assessed using the Montreal Cognitive Assessment (MoCA). Risk estimation accuracy was evaluated using receiver operating characteristic analysis and multivariate logistic regression, adjusting for relevant clinical covariates. RESULTS: Of 504 enrolled patients, 491 completed POD assessment (mean [SD] age, 68.4 [8.3] years; 385 [78.4%] male), of whom 106 (21.6%) developed POD. In multiple linear regression, pTau217 (beta = -0.51; 95% CI, -0.89 to -0.12; P = .01) and age (beta = -0.12; 95% CI, -0.16 to -0.08; P < .001) remained significant factors associated with lower MoCA scores. Patients who developed POD had higher preoperative Abeta1-40, Abeta1-42, pTau217, and Abeta1-40/Abeta1-42 x pTau217, and lower Abeta1-42/Abeta1-40. Abeta1-40 was the independent biomarker most strongly associated with POD (area under the receiver operating curve [AUC], 0.65; 95% CI, 0.59-0.71; P < .001). Combining biomarkers with clinical factors improved risk estimation (AUC, 0.74; 95% CI, 0.69-0.79; P < .001) compared with clinical factors alone (AUC, 0.73; 95% CI, 0.67-0.78; P < .001). A combined model including MoCA achieved an AUC of 0.77 (95% CI, 0.72-0.82; P < .001), driven primarily by Abeta1-40. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this prospective cohort study, preoperative Abeta1-40 showed the strongest association with POD risk among the measured biomarkers. These findings suggest that preoperative plasma Abeta1-40 may contribute to POD risk stratification, but further research is needed to validate these findings and determine clinical utility.

sections.text: 探讨术前血浆阿尔茨海默病生物标志物是否与基线认知相关，并能否独立估计择期心脏手术患者的POD风险。

sections.heading: 设计、地点与参与者
sections.text: 这项前瞻性观察性队列研究（FIND Delirium Risk Factors [FINDERI]）纳入2021年2月1日至2022年10月31日期间在德国一家综合性心脏外科中心接受择期心脏手术的50岁及以上患者。统计分析于2025年1月至12月进行。

sections.heading: 暴露
sections.text: 于2022年11月1日至2024年7月31日期间，使用验证过的免疫测定法测量术前血浆中淀粉样蛋白-β 1-40（Abeta1-40）、淀粉样蛋白-β 1-42（Abeta1-42）、磷酸化tau蛋白181（pTau181）和磷酸化tau蛋白217（pTau217）的浓度。

sections.heading: 主要结局与测量指标
sections.text: 主要结局是POD，术后连续5天使用意识模糊评估法算法进行评估。基线认知功能使用蒙特利尔认知评估（MoCA）进行评估。风险估计准确性通过受试者工作特征分析和多变量逻辑回归进行评估，并校正相关临床协变量。

sections.heading: 结果
sections.text: 在504名入组患者中，491名完成了POD评估（平均[SD]年龄，68.4[8.3]岁；385名[78.4%]男性），其中106名（21.6%）出现了POD。在多元线性回归中，pTau217（beta = -0.51；95% CI，-0.89至-0.12；P = .01）和年龄（beta = -0.12；95% CI，-0.16至-0.08；P < .001）仍是与较低MoCA评分显著相关的因素。出现POD的患者术前Abeta1-40、Abeta1-42、pTau217以及Abeta1-40/Abeta1-42×pTau217水平较高，而Abeta1-42/Abeta1-40水平较低。Abeta1-40是与POD最相关的独立生物标志物（受试者工作特征曲线下面积[AUC]，0.65；95% CI，0.59-0.71；P < .001）。与单独使用临床因素（AUC，0.73；95% CI，0.67-0.78；P < .001）相比，生物标志物与临床因素结合可改善风险估计（AUC，0.74；95% CI，0.69-0.79；P < .001）。包含MoCA的联合模型AUC达到0.77（95% CI，0.72-0.82；P < .001），其中主要驱动因素为Abeta1-40。

sections.heading: 结论与意义
sections.text: 在这项前瞻性队列研究中，术前Abeta1-40在所测量的生物标志物中与POD风险的关联性最强。这些发现提示术前血浆Abeta1-40可能有助于POD风险分层，但需要进一步研究来验证这些发现并确定其临床实用性。

articles.title: 静脉丙泊酚与吸入挥发性麻醉药后恢复轨迹的可行性先导试验（THRIVE）：实用随机临床试验
articles.originalTitle: Feasibility Pilot Trial for the Trajectories of Recovery after Intravenous Propofol versus Inhaled Volatile Anesthesia (THRIVE) Pragmatic Randomized Clinical Trial.
articles.abstract: BACKGROUND: The Trajectories of Recovery after Intravenous propofol versus inhaled VolatilE anesthesia (THRIVE) trial is a multicenter prospective, randomized comparative effectiveness trial examining patients' experiences and outcomes after receiving either total intravenous anesthesia with propofol or inhaled volatile anesthesia for general anesthesia (NCT05991453). Before the 13,000-patient trial, a pilot trial (NCT05346588) was performed to establish feasibility and determine the percentage of success of (1) patient enrollment, (2) intervention adherence, and (3) data completion. METHODS: This feasibility trial included adult patients undergoing elective noncardiac surgery requiring general anesthesia across two academic institutions in the United States. Patients were randomized to receive general anesthesia with total intravenous or inhalational anesthesia. Patients completed surveys on postoperative days 0, 1, 2, 7, 30, and 90. The percentages of consent, intervention adherence, and data completion were compared with predefined thresholds (10%, 80%, and 90%, respectively). RESULTS: A total of 300 patients were enrolled across two sites: Washington University in St. Louis (St. Louis, Missouri) and the University of Michigan (Ann Arbor, Michigan), from September 2022 through March 2023. The percentages achieved significantly exceeded predefined thresholds: 351 of 663 (53%; 95% CI, 49 to 57%) patients approached were successfully consented, adherence to the randomized intervention occurred in 142 of 149 (95%; 95% CI, 92 to 99%) total intravenous anesthesia cases and 150 of 151 (99%; 95% CI, 98 to 100%) inhaled cases, and complete data collection occurred in 279 of 299 (93%; 95% CI, 91 to 96%) patients for the Quality of Recovery-15 and 299 of 299 (100% complete 95% CI, 100 to 100%) patients for the modified Brice, the intraoperative awareness screening questionnaire. CONCLUSIONS: It was feasible to enroll sufficient patients, adhere strongly to the randomized treatment allocation, and obtain adequate outcomes data at these two pilot sites for the THRIVE trial.

sections.heading: BACKGROUND
sections.text: THRIVE试验是一项多中心前瞻性随机比较效果试验，探讨接受全凭静脉丙泊酚麻醉与吸入挥发性麻醉药进行全身麻醉的患者体验和结局（NCT05991453）。在开展13000例患者试验之前，先进行了一项试点试验（NCT05346588），以确定可行性并评估以下方面的成功率：（1）患者入组，（2）干预依从性，（3）数据完整性。

sections.heading: METHODS
sections.text: 本可行性试验纳入美国两所学术机构中择期非心脏手术需全身麻醉的成年患者。患者被随机分配接受全凭静脉麻醉或吸入麻醉。患者在术后第0、1、2、7、30和90天完成问卷调查。将知情同意率、干预依从率和数据完整率与预设阈值（分别为10%、80%和90%）进行比较。

sections.heading: RESULTS
sections.text: 从2022年9月至2023年3月，两中心共入组300例患者：圣路易斯华盛顿大学（密苏里州圣路易斯）和密歇根大学（密歇根州安娜堡）。各百分比显著超过预设阈值：663名接触患者中有351名成功获得知情同意（53%；95% CI, 49%至57%）；149例全凭静脉麻醉中有142例坚持随机分组干预（95%；95% CI, 92%至99%），151例吸入麻醉中有150例坚持（99%；95% CI, 98%至100%）；299例患者中有279例（93%；95% CI, 91%至96%）完成了QoR-15量表的数据收集，299例患者中有299例（100%完整；95% CI, 100%至100%）完成了改良Brice问卷（术中知晓筛查问卷）。

sections.heading: CONCLUSIONS
sections.text: 在这两个THRIVE试验试点中心，入组足够患者、严格坚持随机治疗分组并获得充分的结局数据是可行的。
